about: Grammar topics in HSK order, one topic per session. A topic is built once it has its own file, data/grammar/<id>.json (format: tools/grammar.py). Order after the HSK 2.0 grammar lists of levels 1-3, with each level's topics in the order they build on each other.

topics.title: 是: A is B
topics.focus: Saying who or what someone is: 我是…, 他不是…

topics.title: 吗: yes-no questions
topics.focus: Add 吗 to the end; answer with the verb

topics.title: 很 + adjective
topics.focus: 我很好: adjectives work like verbs, no 是

topics.title: 不: not
topics.focus: 不 before verbs and adjectives; bù or bú

topics.title: 的: my, your, his
topics.focus: 我的, 你的朋友, and when 的 is left out

topics.title: 什么 and 谁: what, who
topics.focus: Question words stay where the answer goes

topics.title: 这 and 那: this, that
topics.focus: 这, 那, 这个, 那个, 这里, 那里

topics.title: 有: to have, there is
topics.focus: 有 and 没有 (never 不有)

topics.title: 在: being somewhere
topics.focus: 我在家, 他在哪里?

topics.title: Numbers and 个
topics.focus: 一个人, 两个, 几个, 多少

topics.title: 想, 要, 喜欢 + verb
topics.focus: Wanting and liking to do something

topics.title: 会 and 能: can
topics.focus: Can because you learned it, or because you're able to

topics.title: Time words come early
topics.focus: 我今天很忙: when goes before the verb

topics.title: 呢: and you?
topics.focus: 你呢? and questions that are already questions

topics.title: 也 and 都: also, all
topics.focus: Both go right before the verb

topics.title: 和: and
topics.focus: 和 joins people and things, not sentences

topics.title: 了 and 没: it happened, it didn't
topics.focus: 我吃了, 我没吃

topics.title: 太…了: too, so
topics.focus: 太好了! and 不太

topics.title: 怎么 and 怎么样: how
topics.focus: How to do something, and how something is

topics.title: 吧: let's, …right?
topics.focus: Suggestions and guesses

topics.title: 了: a new situation
topics.focus: 下雨了, 我不想去了: something has changed

topics.title: 过: have ever
topics.focus: 我去过, 我没去过

topics.title: 在 and 正在: doing right now
topics.focus: 我在吃饭, 他正在工作

topics.title: 着: an ongoing state
topics.focus: 门开着, 他笑着说

topics.title: 要…了: about to
topics.focus: Something is about to happen

topics.title: 是…的: when, where, how
topics.focus: Asking about something that already happened

topics.title: 比: comparing
topics.focus: A 比 B + adjective, and 没有 … 那么

topics.title: 得: how well
topics.focus: 他说得很好: describing how something is done

topics.title: 一下 and 看看
topics.focus: Doing something briefly

topics.title: 别 and 不要: don't
topics.focus: Telling someone not to do something

topics.title: 可以 and 应该: may, should
topics.focus: Permission and advice

topics.title: 给, 跟, 从: to, with, from
topics.focus: Small words before the verb

topics.title: 最 and 更: most, more
topics.focus: 最好, 更好

topics.title: 一点 and 有点: a bit
topics.focus: Which goes where

topics.title: 还是 and 或者: or
topics.focus: 还是 in questions, 或者 in statements

topics.title: 因为…所以: because, so
topics.focus: Giving reasons

topics.title: 虽然…但是: although
topics.focus: Two parts that go together

topics.title: 已经…了: already
topics.focus: Already done or already the case

topics.title: 就 and 才: early, late
topics.focus: Sooner or later than expected

topics.title: 再 and 又: again
topics.focus: Again in the future, again in the past

topics.title: 还: still, also
topics.focus: 还在, 还有, 还没

topics.title: 把: doing something to it
topics.focus: 我把门开了: the object before the verb

topics.title: 被: done to you
topics.focus: Passive sentences

topics.title: Results: 看到, 听懂, 做完
topics.focus: A second verb that says how it ended

topics.title: Directions: 回来, 出去, 起来
topics.focus: Which way the action goes

topics.title: Can or can't: 听得懂, 听不懂
topics.focus: 得 and 不 in the middle of a result

topics.title: 先…然后: first, then
topics.focus: Putting actions in order

topics.title: 一…就: as soon as
topics.focus: One thing right after another

topics.title: 如果…就: if
topics.focus: 如果, 要是, …的话

topics.title: 只要 and 只有: as long as, only if
topics.focus: 只要…就, 只有…才

topics.title: 除了: except, besides
topics.focus: 除了…都, 除了…还

topics.title: 连…都: even
topics.focus: 连他都知道

topics.title: 为了: in order to
topics.focus: Saying what something is for

topics.title: 跟…一样: the same as
topics.focus: Comparing things that are alike

topics.title: 而且 and 甚至: and even
topics.focus: Adding something bigger

topics.title: 会: will, likely
topics.focus: Predictions: 他会来的

topics.title: 一直 and 总是: all along, always
topics.focus: Things that keep happening

topics.title: …的时候, 以前, 以后: when, before, after
topics.focus: Time clauses come first
